## Overview

This portfolio demonstrates end-to-end clinical reporting workflows built on the [pharmaverse](https://pharmaverse.org) ecosystem — a curated collection of open-source R packages designed for clinical trial data analysis and submission-ready reporting.

Work is based on the **CDISC Pilot Project** dataset, a publicly available reference dataset that mirrors real Phase III trial data structures (SDTM and ADaM).

---

## Data Source

| Domain | Standard | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| ADSL   | ADaM     | Subject-level analysis dataset |
| ADAE   | ADaM     | Adverse events |
| ADVS   | ADaM     | Vital signs |
| ADLBC  | ADaM     | Lab chemistry (continuous) |
| ADLBH  | ADaM     | Lab hematology |
| ADTTE  | ADaM     | Time-to-event |
| ADQSADAS | ADaM   | ADAS-Cog questionnaire |

---

## Pharmaverse Packages in Use

| Package | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| [admiral](https://pharmaverse.github.io/admiral/) | ADaM dataset derivation |
| [teal](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal/) | Interactive Shiny exploratory apps |
| [rtables](https://insightsengineering.github.io/rtables/) | Table structure and rendering |
| [tern](https://insightsengineering.github.io/tern/) | Clinical trial analysis functions |
| [riskmetric](https://pharmaverse.github.io/riskmetric/) | Package risk assessment |
| [gtsummary](https://www.danieldsjoberg.com/gtsummary/) | Publication-ready summary tables |
